chunks: We did not wrong them, but they were the ones who wronged themselves.

key_terms.الظَّالِمِينَ: the wrongdoers / those who oppress themselves

ai.seo_question: Who caused the wronging of the people in this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the principle of divine justice (Adl), affirming that God does not arbitrarily punish but rather allows the natural consequences of human free will to manifest. It highlights that misfortune is self-inflicted through moral and spiritual negligence, reinforcing the idea that God's decree is a reflection of human agency rather than capricious will.
